run_pack_tensor_benchmark: run the pack_tensor_benchmark_chunks benchmark to measure tensor packing performance across chunk sizes
run_unpack_tensor_benchmark: run the unpack_tensor_benchmark_chunks benchmark to measure tensor unpacking performance and peak memory
benchmark_pack_tensor_with_compression: benchmark tensor_utils.pack_tensor with zstd or no compression and track compressed versus uncompressed bytes
benchmark_unpack_proto_memory: benchmark tensor_utils.unpack_proto peak memory usage when unpacking a packed tensor with chunks
run_tensor_benchmark_suite: run the google_benchmark.main entry point to execute all registered tensor packing and unpacking benchmarks
